channel.title: Cosmonaut Magazine – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cosmonaut Magazine – Bias and Credibility (cosmonautmag.com)

item.title: Whither History?: Eric Hobsbawm and the Once and Future Left
item.description: Michael Zajakowski Uhll finds in Eric Hobsbawm's "Age of" series not only a rip-roaring narrative that tells us much about the origins of our times, but also inspiration for historians working today, when popular engagement with history is needed more than ever.

item.title: Letter: Investigate, but Verify
item.description: C. Derick Varn responds to Ray F's letter on the need for communist investigation into ruling class conspiracies.

item.title: Letter: Why the Limit is Not a Lack of Opportunity
item.description: Nicolas D Villarreal defends and elaborates on his theories of capitalist development in neoliberalism.

item.title: Letter: Conspiratorial Thought in the Left
item.description: Andie Stewarts argues that conspiratorial thought is a problem in all strains of the left.

item.title: Toward a Marxist State Theory of the Socialist Market Economy
item.description: Arguing that contemporary leftist approaches to China are inadequate on their own, Theryn Arnold draws on Marxist state theory to understand the "socialist market economy" on its own terms as a contradictory social formation where markets cannot be seen as a neutral force.

item.title: On the Zionist Para-State
item.description: In light of the recent war in Iran and the importance of the theoretical questions raised, we have republished Cosmonaut Contributor Rob Ashlar's essays on the Zionist Para-State, accompanied by an updated introduction.

item.title: Going Awry: Žižek’s Misfires in Immigration and Radical Politics
item.description: Raphael F. Alvarenga contends that Žižek’s post-2015 approach to migration, while retaining the language of radical politics, embraces a managerial logic of border control that blunts the universalist and emancipatory thrust of his earlier theory.

item.title: Letter: We Need Organization, Not Idols
item.description: Benjamin Marshall on the failure of left response to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Interview: Oliver Larkin for Congress
item.description: We sit down with Oliver Larkin, who's running for US Congress from Florida's District 23 with revolutionary ambitions.

item.title: Letter: Zionist Para-State and Organized Crime
item.description: Ardoare C. Larna suggests further paths of research into the Zionist Para-State concept. While we understand this letter contains offensive language, we have published it for pedagogical purposes in line with our open editorial policy regarding our letters section, which is meant to be a vehicle for free and open debate among our readership.

item.title: Beyond Revolutionary Romanticism: The Case for Strategic Socialist Transition
item.description: Using the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan as an example, Arjunveer Singh argues against "Revolutionary romanticism" in favor of a more pragmatic and gradualist approach towards transition - "strategic gradualism".

item.title: Letter: U.S. Foreign Policy and the The World Settler Complex
item.description: Gary Levi comments offers commentary on the Zionist Para-State thesis.

item.title: Letter: Errors of "Zionist Para-State" framing
item.description: Benjamin G. argues that Zionist Para-State framing is anti-semitic.

item.title: Letter: Fool's Socialism
item.description: Jean Allen offers their criticisms of the Zionist Para-State Thesis.

item.title: Letter: On the Cuban Question - Holding the Line and Reconstructing Organization
item.description: Benjamin Marshall on the crisis in Cuba and openings for the US left.
